source: lab (captured; background replaced by Segment Anything 2 demo, watermark bottom-right)

objects.name: red_ball
objects.description: single red/orange-red sphere (glossy, white highlights), attached to a thin grey string/cord that trails toward the back; moves in a closed roughly elliptical loop low over the tabletop (pendulum-like swing), ~1 loop per 25 frames; apparent diameter varies ~37-80 px with depth
objects.reference_point: visible centre (circle fit to colour mask); use cy_corr for frames 12-17 (occluded bottom)

objects.name: grey_string
objects.description: thin grey cord/stem attached to the ball, visible as a ~100-150 px grey streak trailing back/up from the ball, partly cut by segmentation; not tracked

objects.name: table
objects.description: brown wooden rectangular tabletop on a single dark-grey central pedestal; long axis left-right (parallel to image x)

image_geometry_px.note: pedestal runs off the bottom of the frame; floor not visible

objects.name: background
objects.description: synthetic replaced background (blue-grey to white gradient with speckle) - not a real surface

objects.name: watermark
